title: 第5章 新的系统任务第6章 暗流涌动
content_zh:
修炼完毕，叶霄尘清洗一番，换上一身崭新的白衣。
他站在铜镜前，看着镜中脱胎换骨后的自己——肌肤如玉，双目有神，整个人气质都发生了微妙的变化。
凡哥，进来吧。
他朝门外唤道。
叶凡端着水盆走进来，目光在叶霄尘身上停留片刻，眼中闪过一丝疑惑。
他总觉得少主似乎哪里不一样了，可又说不上来。
硬要说的话，少主整个人更加自信了，就像是已经可以修炼了一样，可少主身上依旧毫无半分玄气迹象。
叶凡不敢多问，只是默默收拾着洗漱用具。
叶霄尘将叶凡的反应尽收眼底，心中暗笑。
自己佩戴的可是中级敛息玉佩，要是连玄感四重的叶凡都看出来了，那才真是见鬼了。
就在叶霄尘感叹之际，系统又蹦了出来。
【叮！
新任务发布：寻找沧海遗珠】
【千年岁月如尘，曾经辉煌的古老家族已然式微，门庭冷落，青苔爬满残垣。
然而，那源自远古的神秘血脉仍在你们体内悄然流淌，如同沉睡的星河，等待被命运之风吹醒。
或许某个不起眼的角落，正有一位少年眼眸深处闪烁着先祖的荣光……】
【任务内容：发掘族中隐藏天赋的少年】
【任务奖励：回命丹x1（号称只要还有一口气，就可以绝对不死的救命丹药）】
沧海遗珠？叶霄尘眉头一挑。
根据系统的描述来看，这个少年的天赋说不定要远超于他这个地品天赋，

甚至有可能，是觉醒了特殊的血脉！
天赋如此惊人，只要自己给他足够多的资源，那自己岂不是……
嘿嘿……
骚年！
等我！
叶霄尘推门而出，今天，就算是天王老子来了，也不能阻挡他，种下这颗大白……白玉大白菜！
——
叶家宅院占地极广，主要分为五个区域：
中央是家主大殿和议事厅，庄严肃穆；
东侧是嫡系子弟居住的院落，亭台楼阁错落有致；
西侧是练武场和藏书阁，乃修炼重地；
北侧靠近后山，是护卫队和仆役住所；
南侧则是家族产业管理处。
叶霄尘信步来到西侧的练武场。
这里是叶家年轻子弟聚集之地，要是那颗沧海遗珠真的在叶家的话，在这里的可能性最大。
还没到练武场，叶霄尘远远就听到阵阵呼喝声。
三十多名少年正在场中修炼基础玄技。
有的在练习拳法，有的在演练剑招，还有几人在切磋比试。
场边站着几位教习，不时出声指点。
随着叶霄尘三人的到来，练武场上的喧闹声戛然而止。

数十名叶家子弟齐刷刷地停下动作，目光复杂地望了过来。
他怎么来了？一个尖细的女声从人群中传出。
听说前几天走路摔晕过去了，真是丢人……
content_en:
After practicing, Ye Xiaochen washed himself and put on a brand new white clothes.
He stood in front of the bronze mirror and looked at himself in the mirror after his rebirth - his skin was like jade, his eyes were bright, and his whole personality had undergone subtle changes.
Brother Fan, come in.
He called out the door.
Ye Fan walked in with a water basin, his eyes stayed on Ye Xiaochen for a moment, and a trace of doubt flashed in his eyes.
He always felt that something was different about the young master, but he couldn't tell.
To put it bluntly, the young master has become more confident, as if he is ready to practice, but there is still no sign of profound energy in the young master.
Ye Fan didn't dare to ask any more questions, and just packed the toiletries silently.
Ye Xiaochen took in Ye Fan's reaction and smiled secretly in his heart.
What he is wearing is an intermediate breath-condensing jade pendant. If even Ye Fan, who is at the fourth level of Mystic Sense, sees it, that would be a damned thing.
Just when Ye Xiaochen was sighing, the system popped up again.
【bite!
New mission released: Looking for the lost pearl]
[Thousands of years have passed like dust. The once glorious ancient family has declined, its doors and courtyards are deserted, and moss is covering the ruins.
However, the mysterious bloodline originating from ancient times is still flowing quietly in your body, like a sleeping galaxy, waiting to be awakened by the wind of fate.
Perhaps in some inconspicuous corner, there is a young man whose eyes are shining with the glory of his ancestors...]
[Task content: Discover the hidden talents of the young people in the clan]
[Mission Reward: Life-Reviving Pill x1 (a life-saving pill that is said to make you absolutely immortal as long as you still have one breath)]
A hidden gem? Ye Xiaochen raised his eyebrows.
According to the description of the system, this young man's talent may far exceed his earth-level talent.
It's even possible that a special bloodline has been awakened!
His talent is so amazing, as long as I give him enough resources, wouldn't I...
Hehe...
Sao Nian!
wait for me!
Ye Xiaochen pushed the door open and walked out. Today, even if the King of Heaven comes, he can't stop him from planting this white... white jade cabbage!
——
The Ye Family Mansion occupies a very large area and is mainly divided into five areas:
In the center is the main hall and the meeting hall of the family, which are solemn and solemn;
On the east side is the courtyard where the direct descendants live, with pavilions and pavilions arranged in an orderly manner;
On the west side are the martial arts training ground and library, which are important places for training;
The north side, near the back mountain, is the residence of the guards and servants;
On the south side is the family industry management office.
Ye Xiaochen strolled to the martial arts training ground on the west side.
This is where the young people of the Ye family gather. If the hidden gem is really in the Ye family, it is most likely to be here.
Before he arrived at the martial arts training ground, Ye Xiaochen heard shouts from a distance.
More than thirty teenagers are practicing basic mystical skills in the field.
Some are practicing boxing, some are rehearsing sword moves, and a few are sparring.
Several teachers stood on the sidelines, giving guidance from time to time.
With the arrival of Ye Xiaochen and the others, the noise in the martial arts training ground suddenly stopped.
Dozens of Ye family disciples stopped in unison and looked over with complicated eyes.
Why is he here? A high-pitched female voice came from the crowd.
I heard that I fainted after falling while walking a few days ago. It’s really embarrassing...
